content_preview.title: GitHub Retires macOS 14 Actions Runner Image on November 2, With Eight Job-Failing Brownouts Starting October 5
content_preview.summary: GitHub will retire the macOS 14 runner image on November 2, 2026 and fail jobs using it in eight October brownout windows; Azure DevOps hosted agents follow the same schedule.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

GitHub will retire the macOS 14 runner image for GitHub Actions on November 2, 2026, and will deliberately fail jobs that still use it during eight scheduled brownout windows in October, according to a [GitHub Changelog entry dated October 1](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-01-github-actions-macos-14-runner-image-retirement). The first window opens on October 5.

## What We Know

- **Retirement date.** The changelog says [the macOS 14 runner image will be retired on November 2...

editor_notes.content_quality: Tight ~400-word Briefing with Overview, What We Know, Azure DevOps, rationale and What We Don't Know sections. Schedule-focused and easy to act on. Neutral tone, no AI self-reference.
editor_notes.source_verification: Read all three snapshots from disk (gunzip -c) and verified against the article; none needed WebFetch. source-0.html.gz (github.blog changelog, Oct 1, 2026, status 200): 'The macOS 14 runner image will be retired on November 2, 2026'; eight brownout periods, each '14:00 UTC to ... 00:00 UTC' the next day: Oct 5 (to Oct 6), Oct 12 (to 13), Oct 16 (to 17), Oct 19 (to 20), Oct 23 (to 24), Oct 26 (to 27), Oct 29 (to 30), Oct 30 (to 31). Article's 'eight windows ... 14:00 UTC to 00:00 UTC the next day, starting on October 5, 12, 16, 19, 23, 26, 29 and 30' matches exactly; UTC is stated in the source so the article's time-zone statement is supported. Labels macos-14, macos-14-large, macos-14-xlarge confirmed; capacity-reduction/longer-queue sentence confirmed; migration targets macos-latest (macos-26), macos-15, macos-latest-xlarge (macos-26-xlarge), macos-15-xlarge confirmed verbatim. source-1.html.gz (actions/runner-images issue #13518, opened Jan 11, 2026 by erik-bershel): deprecation begins July 6, 2026, 'fully unsupported by November 2nd, 2026 for GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps'; identical eight brownout windows (same dates/times, UTC); 'Workflows using the macos-14, macos-14-large, macos-14-xlarge image labels will be terminated with an error'; 'GitHub Actions maintains the latest two stable versions of any given OS version.' (verbatim match to the article's quoted rationale). Changelog and issue schedules agree with each other. source-2.html.gz (Microsoft Learn, hosted-deprecation-schedule, page 'Last updated on 2026-02-02'): the snapshot DOES contain the macOS 14 Sonoma entry: 'Deprecation start date: July 6, 2026. Brownout schedule: October 5, 2026 to October 31, 2026. Scheduled removal date: November 2, 2026.', with the same eight dated windows listed (14:00 UTC - 00:00 UTC). So the article's claim that Azure Pipelines follows the same schedule is confirmed in detail, not only by range. Recommended action 'macos-latest or macos-15' matches; self-hosted agents not affected ('doesn't impact customers using macOS 14 Sonoma agents in self-hosted agents') and 'container images aren't impacted' confirmed. Allowlist: github.blog, github.com and learn.microsoft.com are all on config/source_allowlist.txt. suspicious_patterns is null for all three sources; nothing to adjudicate. No snapshot failures, no archive fallbacks.
editor_notes.factual_accuracy: Every date, count, time, label and migration target traces to a cited source. Minor tense nuance: the article says the issue 'says deprecation began on July 6, 2026'; the issue (written in January) says deprecation 'will begin' on July 6th. By October 2 the date has passed and the schedule is unchanged on Learn, so this is not a factual error. The Azure DevOps section cites the Learn brownout range (Oct 5 to Oct 31) correctly. The Learn page was last updated Feb 2026 and still carries the entry, consistent with the Oct 1 changelog. The two migration lists differ slightly between sources (changelog lists only arm64 macos-latest/-15/-xlarge labels; Learn recommends macos-latest or macos-15); the article attributes each list to the correct source. Nothing rests on assumption.
editor_notes.tone_assessment: Neutral, factual, appropriate for a schedule briefing.
editor_notes.originality: No existing article covers the macOS 14 runner retirement; the only related prior piece is the May 2026 custom runner images GA article (different topic). New topic.
recommendations: Consider noting that the issue-announced July 6 deprecation start has already passed (past tense is used, which is acceptable).
editor_notes.overall_assessment: Accurate, fully sourced schedule briefing. All eight brownout windows, retirement date, labels, migration guidance and the Azure DevOps parity claim verified verbatim against the snapshots. APPROVE.
